THE FIX: `hooks.modify_damage_additive` and `hooks.modify_block_additive` fold each listener's delta into the running amount and RETURN the new amount, exactly as `ModifyDamageInternal` does it (`num2 = item.ModifyDamageAdditive(target, num, props, dealer, cardSource); num += num2;` -- Hook.cs:2515-2526) and as `ModifyBlock` does its twin (Hook.cs:1310-1340). They used to hand every listener the pre-step base and return the SUM OF THE DELTAS, which the five call sites then added to the base again; those sites (DamageCmd.deal, BlockCmd.apply, both previews, and Thrash's damage calc) now apply the returned value directly, which is the shape the multiplicative pair was given on 2026-07-27. The `out modifiers` behaviour is unchanged: a listener joins the list only when its delta is non-zero. WHY IT WAS DORMANT, enumerated rather than reasoned. All 13 overrides of ModifyDamageAdditive or ModifyBlockAdditive in the decompiled source -- Accuracy, Calcify, Dexterity, Fasten, Leadership, PhantomBlades, Strength, Tainted, Vigor, FakeStrikeDummy, MiniatureCannon, MysticLighter, StrikeDummy -- IGNORE the `amount`/`block` parameter entirely: each one either returns `0m` from a guard chain or returns a constant (`base.Amount`, or a DynamicVar's BaseValue/IntValue).
